title: Variation 1: The Round Table
prompt:
**Bài toán.** Same market rules, but the stalls are arranged in a **circle**:
stall n is adjacent to stall 1. Choose a non-adjacent subset with maximum
total revenue.

**Constraints:** 2 ≤ n ≤ 200000; 0 ≤ a[i] ≤ 10^6.

**Input:** line 1: n; line 2: n values.
**Output:** one integer.

tests.name: sample
tests.hint: Stalls 1 and 3 → 9+1 = 10; the two ends are ring-adjacent, so 9+9 = 18 is illegal — the linear wrong reports 18.

tests.name: all equal
two stalls
tests.hint: In a 2-ring the stalls are adjacent (twice over) → only one can run.

tests.name: full scale
tests.hint: Case split: the answer never uses both endpoints — two linear passes.
